facts.text: The villas were designed by Foster + Partners and are inspired by seashells.

facts.text: Villas are either floating above the water or set on the sand.

facts.text: Each villa has panoramic windows, open living space, a sea-view pool and a telescope for stargazing.
facts.excerpt: features panoramic windows, open living space, a sea-view pool and a telescope to discover Saudi Arabia’s enchanting star-filled sky.

facts.text: The Royal Nujuma Villa is the resort's most expansive accommodation.
facts.excerpt: the Royal Nujuma Villa is our most expansive accommodation

facts.text: Sita has a French-style patisserie and a Levantine restaurant with moment-prepared hummus and a central clay oven.
facts.excerpt: Sita features a French-style patisserie, a Levantine restaurant offering moment-prepared hummus, a spice library for flavorful mezze, and a central clay oven perfuming fresh bread

facts.text: Tabrah is a seafood restaurant that interprets Saudi Arabia's fishing tradition.
facts.excerpt: Tabrah is a culinary interpretation of Saudi Arabia’s fishing tradition

facts.text: Maia is a bar focused on astronomy, with mocktails inspired by the night sky.
facts.excerpt: At this Red Sea bar, the focus on astronomy extends to mocktails, concoctions inspired by the night sky.

facts.text: Neyrah Spa has sea-facing treatment rooms, outdoor treatment cabins, yoga pavilions, vitality and lap pools, a hammam and a fitness center.
facts.excerpt: Neyrah Spa is a free-flowing space with sea-facing treatment rooms and outdoor treatment cabins; private and shared yoga pavilions, vitality and lap pools; hammam and rhassoul; a fitness center

facts.text: Galaxea Dive Center lets guests learn to dive, earn a certification and join diving excursions.
facts.excerpt: Led by the experts at Galaxea Dive Center, guests can learn how to dive, earn a certification and explore the depths of the sea

facts.text: The Conservation House is a bridge to Saudi Arabia's marine life, history and heritage.
facts.excerpt: the Conservation House is a bridge to Saudi Arabia’s marine life, history and heritage.

facts.text: A resident astronomy expert leads stargazing and storytelling for guests.
facts.excerpt: Led by our resident astronomy expert, who marries his passion for stargazing and storytelling

facts.text: The Kids and Teens Club is designed for guests aged 12 and under.
facts.excerpt: Designed for guests aged 12 and under, our Kids and Teens Club offers engaging activities
